scope: One version-correct x86 Microsoft Common Controls TreeView path only; not a claim for all VB extensions or all MSCOMCTL versions.

source.signature: Valid Microsoft Corporation Authenticode signature; extracted administratively to task scratch only
source.historical_hash_note: The current Microsoft download hash differs from the historical SHA-256 published by the linked KB. The mismatch is recorded; no claim is made that the two files are identical.

safety.research_location: build/t17-s28-ocx-research (ignored task scratch, to be removed after evidence is retained)

observed_public_contract.activation: Direct DllGetClassObject, IClassFactory, IOleObject and IPersistStreamInit; no registry lookup
observed_public_contract.module_identity: Both classes report the same loaded MSCOMCTL.OCX HMODULE
observed_public_contract.protocol: Existing public TreeView checks: child/same-thread ownership, cbWndExtra, WM_GETDLGCODE, TVM_GETCOUNT, TVM_GETINDENT, TVM_GETITEMHEIGHT, TVM_GETNEXTITEM, TVM_HITTEST, non-RTL and non-frame styles. No OCX private object data is read.

pre_fix: The styled process contained ntw16s32.dll but TreeView20WndClass reported attached=0, because only SysTreeView32, TTreeView and TShellTreeView reached the protocol binder.
implementation: Add a narrow TreeView20WndClass admission path only when the child and CtlFrameWork_ReflectWindow parent are both registered by a module whose loaded filename is MSCOMCTL.OCX. It reuses the existing TreeView public-protocol validator and existing tree painter; no new renderer, hook, ABI, graphics resource or OCX dependency is introduced.

listview_diagnostic.contract: The same direct OLE host can set the public IDispatch View property to report mode before activation. It then creates ListView20WndClass and an MSCOMCTL-owned msvb_lib_header.
listview_diagnostic.result: The current scoped creation hook sees the early window messages, but no stable ListView public contract exists at the bounded attachment point. The final product intentionally reports attached=0 for this ListView path.
listview_diagnostic.decision: ListView remains native. No global hook, existing-window scan, OCX registration, or private-object inspection was added. A future implementation needs a separately reviewed, explicit OCX activation boundary.

verification.positive: Candidate run16s injected the self-owned x86 core-ocx-tree-host with the extracted MSCOMCTL.OCX. Output: OCX_TREE_HOST_RESULT class=TreeView20WndClass attached=1 expected=1 dpi=96; exit=0.
verification.negative: The same scratch OCX byte stream under filename mscomctl-renamed.OCX created the same class but output attached=0 expected=0; exit=0. This detects an over-broad class-name-only implementation.
verification.permanent_probe: tests/ntw16s-dll/ocx_tree_host.c is a pure-C optional native probe. It requires an explicit user-supplied licensed path, never registers the component, and is not part of required CTest or package inputs.
verification.remaining: ListView, Toolbar, StatusBar, TabStrip, ProgressBar, Slider, ImageCombo and every other OCX row remain unverified and native. This evidence covers neither their window contracts nor their painting.
